task_text: Add docs/dogfood-automation.md and tests/integrations/test_dogfood_automation.py. The guide and non-executing integration test must demonstrate a private executor consuming an advisory assess result while preserving execution_authorized=false and authorized_write_scope=[], requiring status=recommended, and treating the selected logical profile as a recommendation that is mapped and executed only under separate current user authority. Do not add provider calls, model names, network access, execution dispatch, or production behavior changes.
title: document advisory private executor integration
